methods.source_location: Experiment, page 578: unit-cell parameters were measured using the Mao et al. (1986) ruby fluorescence pressure scale.

recalculation.notes: All row-wise sample volumes and source-scale pressures are bundled. The exact Mao-1986 ruby equation is executable; reported pressures can be inverted to normalized R1 wavelength before applying another ruby calibration.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: Checked directly against the final IUCr article and its complete printed Table 1.

primary_source_check.finding: The source's preferred rhombohedral Fe0.93O parameterization is the ambient-reference BM3 cross-check on all nine 27.7-51.1 GPa rows, with V0 and K0 varied and K0'=4 fixed.

source_locations: Table 1, all 16 shared pressure rows and all phase-specific lattice/volume values
primary_data_check.finding: The complete multiphase table is transcribed, including all nine rhombohedral a, c, equivalent-hexagonal volume, and estimated-standard-deviation values.

independent_refit.model: Third-order Birch-Murnaghan with K0_prime fixed at 4.0
independent_refit.selection: The nine Table 1 rows flagged fe093o_rhombohedral_fit_included=1; no synthetic ambient point.
independent_refit.objective: Effective-variance pressure residuals using the printed equivalent-hexagonal volume standard deviations and 0.075 GPa as the midpoint of the source's stated 0.05-0.1 GPa pressure precision range.
independent_refit.conclusion: Both free coefficients reproduce the preferred published values within their reported uncertainties.

numerical_reproduction.limitation: The midpoint pressure precision is an explicit deterministic audit choice, not a reconstruction of undocumented EOS-FIT weights; the source publishes no covariance or confidence convention.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Experiment, pages 577-578; Results section 3.1 and Table 1, pages 579-580; Figure 5, page 580.
parameter_provenance.equation: Results section 3.1 and Figure 5, pages 579-580: third-order Birch-Murnaghan treatment with an ambient-reference cross-check.
parameter_provenance.V0: Results section 3.1, page 580: preferred ambient-reference fit V0=59.72(22) A^3, varied without adding a synthetic P0 observation.
parameter_provenance.K0: Results section 3.1, page 580: preferred ambient-reference fit K0=134(4) GPa, varied.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Results section 3.1, page 580: fixed at 4.0 in the preferred ambient-reference fit.
parameter_provenance.volume_basis: Table 1 explicitly reports equivalent-hexagonal-cell volumes. The paper's conversion of V0=59.72 A^3 to 11.99 cm^3/mol establishes three formula units per represented cell.
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: The source identifies the ambient lattice measurements as 300 K and reports a room-temperature static compression experiment.
